plain: One who believes in a creator god but not in a god revealed through scripture.

webster.text: One who believes in the existence of a God, but denies revealed religion; one who professes no form of religion, but follows the light of nature and reason, as his only guides in doctrine and practice; a freethinker.

example.quote: and that it would admit deists, atheists, &c., into the general government;
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Dr. JARVIS, January 30, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
